thread:
jordan_cust: Hey team, started getting SSO failures about 30m after our IdP rotated signing certs. Some users succeed, others get a 400 with "RecipientMismatch" or "Signature verification failed". Behavior is intermittent.

jordan_cust: From our logs: 
```
SAML error: RecipientMismatch: expected https://app.acme.com/sso/acs got https://app.acme.com/prod/sso/acs
SAML error: Signature verification failed: no matching key found for KeyInfo
```

jordan_cust: We suspect our edge/proxy adds a /prod prefix and the IdP metadata might still reference the non-prefixed ACS. IdP claims they rotated certs and updated metadata at 09:50 UTC.

alice_support: Thanks Jordan — I've opened an incident and will coordinate. Can you paste a redacted decoded SAMLResponse XML (one failing example) and the tenant id + IdP metadata URL? I'll escalate to eng.

deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: INC-128019 — priority: high — assigned to support. https://tickets.redwood.example/INC-128019

jordan_cust: Tenant: acme-inc. Metadata: https://idp.acme.example/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml

jordan_cust: Decoded assertion (redacted):
```
<saml:Assertion>
  <saml:Subject>
    <saml:NameID>user@acme.example</saml:NameID>
    <saml:SubjectConfirmation>
      <saml:SubjectConfirmationData Recipient="https://app.acme.com/prod/sso/acs" NotOnOrAfter="2026-03-15T11:05:00Z"/>
    </saml:SubjectConfirmation>
  </saml:Subject>
  <saml:Conditions>
    <saml:AudienceRestriction>
      <saml:Audience>https://app.acme.com/</saml:Audience>
    </saml:AudienceRestriction>
  </saml:Conditions>
  <ds:Signature>
    <!-- signature present; verification depends on metadata certs -->
  </ds:Signature>
</saml:Assertion>
```

alice_support: Two likely concurrent issues: (1) recipient/ACS mismatch due to proxy path, and (2) intermittent signature failures from cert rotation + cached metadata. Looping in @mike and @lisa to investigate caching and rotation hygiene.

mike_eng-saml: Quick questions: are you rewriting SP metadata through the proxy, or is the IdP calling back to the post-proxy URL? Also note our metadata fetcher caches per-tenant metadata up to 12h by default; if their metadata changed but an edge/CDN cached an older copy that would explain flakiness.

mike_eng-saml: Commands we run to debug:
```
# decode SAMLResponse from POST body
echo 'BASE64_SAML_RESPONSE' | base64 -d | xmllint --format -

# fetch IdP metadata and fingerprint certs
curl -s 'https://idp.acme.example/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml' | xmllint --xpath 'string(//ds:X509Certificate)' - | base64 -d | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256
```

lisa_security: On rotation: IdPs should publish both old and new signing certs during a rollover window. If they remove the old cert immediately, SPs (or stale caches) that still validate with the old key will fail. Mitigations: IdP include both KeyDescriptor entries for use="signing" for at least one TTL cycle; SP/support allow a manual metadata refresh and consider temporary lower TTLs during rotation.

alice_support: Jordan — can you run the curl/fingerprint check and share the values (redacted ok)? Also confirm if a CDN/CDN-edge sits in front of the metadata URL.

jordan_cust: Pulled metadata; both certs now present. Fingerprints (redacted):
- OLD: SHA256:AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:...:11
- NEW: SHA256:11:22:33:44:55:...:FF

jordan_cust: Our kong + CDN returned an older metadata fetch at 09:55 containing only the old cert; origin updated at 09:56 with both certs, so a cache race seems likely.

mike_eng-saml: That matches our refresher logs. For tenant acme-inc our fetcher attempted a refresh at 09:57 but served a cached copy until ~10:15 because of the per-tenant cache TTL. Recommendations: (1) manual metadata refresh via admin API; (2) short-term allow alternate ACS in SP config to accept proxied path.

mike_eng-saml: Example API call to force refresh:
```
POST /admin/tenants/acme-inc/metadata/refresh
Authorization: Bearer <support-token>
```

mike_eng-saml: Example SP config to accept both ACS endpoints:
```yaml
sp:
  entity_id: https://app.acme.com/
  assertion_consumer_services:
    - index: 0
      binding: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST
      location: https://app.acme.com/sso/acs
    - index: 1
      binding: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST
      location: https://app.acme.com/prod/sso/acs
```

mike_eng-saml: Note accepting multiple ACS URLs is OK if you control the proxy; best practice is IdP metadata reference the public (post-proxy) callback URL.

alice_support: I triggered a manual refresh for acme-inc and cleared the tenant metadata cache. I also asked infra to purge CDN edges for the metadata path. Can you retry logins?

jordan_cust: Tried a few sign-ins — failures dropped but a handful still show up. After the purge the remaining failures are consistently "RecipientMismatch" rather than signature errors.

jordan_cust: Side question: does KeyDescriptor ordering matter? Some SAML libs pick the first key when multiple are present.

lisa_security: Good question — some older libs prefer the first KeyDescriptor. IdP should ideally include both keys and keep the old one during rollover; short-term they can make the new key first. Also document the rollover so customers can plan TTLs.

mike_eng-saml: We pushed a small change to our refresher to respect Cache-Control/Expires from IdPs and to expose a manual override. Long-term we will surface per-tenant metadata TTLs in the console.

alice_support: Proposed remediation for acme-inc:
1) Ask IdP to include both certs and present the public/proxied ACS URL in metadata (or keep SP accepting alternate ACS).
2) Keep old cert in metadata for a short TTL cycle or place new cert first.
3) We cleared caches and purged CDN edges; please monitor for 2h.
4) We'll add an alert when signature verification error rate spikes.

jordan_cust: IdP updated metadata to include proxied ACS (https://app.acme.com/prod/sso/acs) and left both certs. Re-tests: 0/20 failures. Looks resolved on our end. Thanks!

alice_support: Great — marking INC-128019 resolved. We can keep monitoring for 24h if you'd like.

jordan_cust: Please do keep an eye for 24h. Thanks @mike_eng-saml and @lisa_security for the quick turnaround. :tada: 

deploy-bot: Incident INC-128019 resolved by alice_support — closed at 2026-03-15T11:20:00Z

mike_eng-saml: Follow-up: add per-tenant metadata refresh button in console and publish a KB about cert rotation best practices for customers.

alice_support: I'll draft the KB and loop in eng for review. :thumbsup:
